items.title: When Does Belief-Based Agent Memory Help? Reliability-Conditional Updating and Provenance-Capped Poisoning Defense
items.title_zh: 基于信念的智能体记忆何时有用？可靠性条件更新与来源封顶的投毒防御
items.summary: Nous represents each entity-attribute pair as a categorical probability distribution updated by closed-form Bayesian inference, with information-theoretic surprise driving belief revision and entropy-based forgetting. A controlled LoCoMo ablation finds Bayesian updating alone barely beats last-write-wins, but reliability-conditioned updating substantially outperforms last-write-wins and raw-memory retrieval when observations differ in trustworthiness, and provenance-capped updating resists volumetric memory poisoning; the paper also reports a 27.5-point discrepancy between strict token-F1 and LLM-as-judge evaluation on identical outputs.

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.title_zh: 新颖性感知的智能体检索：通过结构化多步推理比较研究贡献
items.summary: The Novelty-Aware Research Agent layers six typed-contract components, including query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, schema-guided contribution extraction, and a three-pass comparison agent, on a RAG pipeline to produce per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem-by-method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus it supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, with mean Precision@5 of 1.000 and nDCG@5 of 0.752 on the main queries.

items.title: FeLoG: Scalable and Efficient Distributed Graph Embedding with Feedback Loop Mechanism
items.title_zh: FeLoG：带反馈环机制的可扩展高效分布式图嵌入
items.summary: FeLoG is a distributed graph-embedding system that couples sampling with real-time embedding-quality feedback to prioritize undertrained nodes, adds activity-aware communication compression, and overlaps next-round sampling with current-round training. Against six state-of-the-art baselines on large-scale graphs it reports an average 27.9x speedup, more than 53.1% lower communication cost, and over 80% CPU-GPU utilization, with graph-based retrieval-augmented generation among its target applications.

items.title: CodeTeam: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Framework for Repository-Level Code Generation
items.title_zh: CodeTeam：面向仓库级代码生成的 LLM 多智能体框架
items.summary: CodeTeam separates natural-language-to-repository generation into planning, decision making, and implementation: multiple Architect agents draft competing design sketches, a CTO agent selects and normalizes one into a machine-checkable contract, and Developer agents build code under a dependency-aware scheduler with Git-based coordination while a QA agent drives repairs. On the SketchEval benchmark across 19 repositories under a retrieval-free protocol, its prompt-engineering variant improves the mean structural score by 3.84 points over CodeS (53.88 versus 50.04).

items.title: Lexical Consensus: Grounded Word Learning and Shared Meaning in Artificial Agents
items.title_zh: 词汇共识：人工智能体中有依据的词语学习与共享意义
items.summary: Lexical Consensus studies grounded word learning over frozen DINOv2 visual embeddings with Carroll-style nonce words, testing whether agents acquire artificial labels for visual concepts, generalize them bidirectionally, and stabilize them across controlled settings. It finds a perceptual-coherence gradient governed by perceptual rather than semantic distance, and shows naming and retrieval are distinct, with exemplar-based mechanisms outperforming centroid prototypes in label-to-image retrieval.

items.title: SamatNext v0.2-B: An Exploratory Study of RMS-Normalized Hybrid Decoders for Curriculum Retention in Small Code Models
items.title_zh: SamatNext v0.2-B：面向小型代码模型课程保持的 RMS 归一化混合解码器探索性研究
items.summary: SamatNext v0.2-B is an experimental 356M-parameter hybrid decoder that alternates differential-attention-style layers with DeltaNet-inspired linear-state mixers under RMS normalization, evaluated on a staged Python code curriculum against a parameter-matched Transformer. It reaches a 100.0% pass rate on the Stage 5 holdout while retaining 98.8% of adjacent Stage 3 behavior, versus 97.6% and 6.0% for the Transformer baseline, though both remain weak on long-horizon early-stage retention.

items.title: Revelio: Cost-Efficient Agentic Memory Safety Vulnerability Detection For Repository-Scale Codebases
items.title_zh: Revelio：面向仓库级代码库的低成本智能体内存安全漏洞检测
items.summary: Revelio combines inexpensive LLMs with lightweight static analysis to generate and rank vulnerability hypotheses, then confirms them with an executable proof-of-vulnerability checked by a sanitizer. Across seven long-fuzzed projects and 100 Arvo projects it found 19 previously unknown memory-safety bugs for about $300 and roughly one hour per project.

items.title: L20-Edu-135M: An Auditable Single-GPU Study of Data-Efficient Small Language Modeling
items.title_zh: L20-Edu-135M：单 GPU 数据高效小语言建模的可审计研究
items.summary: L20-Edu-135M is a 134.5M-parameter language model trained end-to-end on a single NVIDIA L20 GPU on roughly 13B tokens, with documented data gates, near-deduplication, benchmark-overlap removal, supervised fine-tuning with weight interpolation, and RLVR on GSM8K. It trails SmolLM-135M on a self-run six-task harness (mean 0.4150 versus 0.4767) while using 2.17% of its nominal token count, and direct GRPO-style RLVR decreased GSM8K exact-match accuracy in the reported single runs.

items.title: Temporary Cloudflare accounts for AI agents
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 为 AI Agent 推出临时账户
items.summary: Cloudflare is rolling out Temporary Accounts on Workers, letting any agent deploy a live Worker in seconds rather than hitting account-creation walls built for humans.
